title: reverse_number
prompt: Given a non-negative int n, return it with its digits reversed. e.g. n=1234 returns 4321. Use a while loop, the same digit-peeling idea as digit_sum.
solution:
def reverse_number(n):
    reversed_n = 0
    while n > 0:
        digit = n % 10
        reversed_n = reversed_n * 10 + digit
        n //= 10
    return reversed_n
